name: Wyrmspan
description: Wingspan with dragons for 1–5: excavate caves, entice dragons, hatch eggs and climb the Dragon Guild.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** by Stonemaier Games (Wyr_Rulebook r19), from their public rules folder linked on the [Wyrmspan page](https://stonemaiergames.com/games/wyrmspan/).
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages. Icons are described in words, so check the page image for those. Tap any page image to see it as printed.

Stonemaier also has a [rules and FAQ page](https://stonemaiergames.com/games/wyrmspan/rules-faq/) with a how-to-play video, a separate **Automa** rulebook for solo play, and rules for the **Dragon Academy** expansion.
